'''Haroun bread''' was a [[Color/Legends|brown]],<ref name="VD" /> rustic [[Bread/Legends|bread]] baked by [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] on the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Tatooine">{{CSWECite|III|224|Tatooine}}</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was often served with<ref name="CSWE" /> the spicy food [[Ahrisa/Legends|ahrisa]].<ref name="VD" />
